subject.title: feat(github-copilot): add native web search for Copilot GPT models

question: After consolidating the shared implementation, should eligible GitHub Copilot OpenAI Responses models automatically use Copilot-hosted native web search when no managed provider is pinned?
rationale: The duplicated implementation is mechanically repairable, but changing the automatic provider route for existing Copilot users still requires maintainer product intent.

options.title: Consolidate and adopt
options.body: Use one shared implementation and approve automatic Copilot-native search after live provider proof.

options.title: Retain managed routing
options.body: Decline automatic native search and keep the current managed-provider behavior for GitHub Copilot.

recommendation.title: Consolidate and adopt
recommendation.body: Use one shared implementation and approve automatic Copilot-native search after live provider proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work spans both the Copilot wrapper and the shared provider payload seam that define this choice.
